##### Project general facts

Artist Hotel on Rainy Street is a distinctive hospitality concept that merges artful design with immersive island living. This boutique hotel invites guests into a world where every corner is inspired by creativity and every stay is a unique experience. The architecture and interiors reflect bold, expressive aesthetics, set against the atmospheric charm of rain and snow-themed surroundings, creating an escape unlike any other in Dubai.

Deluxe units at Artist Hotel are designed to provide a seamless blend of comfort and visual storytelling, with views over Rainy Street and Snow Plaza. A confluence of sun, sea, and laidback island living meets the region's largest curated art collection and immersive residencies. Designed by artists and made for creators, inspiration takes root here, quietly transforming every stay into an unforgettable encounter. Each room evokes emotion and inspiration, making the hotel not just a place to stay, but a destination to remember.

Every space at Artist Hotel is crafted with modern finishing using high-quality materials and fully equipped kitchens. From the artistic elements integrated into the décor to the thoughtfully curated layouts, each room is designed to leave a lasting impression. The interiors reflect bold, expressive aesthetics, creating a creative enclave mere moments from the city's hum.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within The World Islands, a remarkable man-made archipelago located off the coast of Dubai, this exceptional location offers a symbol of opulence and grandeur. The ambitious development comprises a collection of small islands shaped like a world map, each representing a different country or region, designed to offer luxurious and exclusive living experiences.

The location is distinguished by its unparalleled privacy and exclusivity. The islands provide an elite retreat for residents and visitors, offering lavish villas, mansions, and private estates with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and access to pristine beaches. High-end resorts, boutique hotels, and entertainment facilities ensure world-class dining, spa treatments, and water sports are always within reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies artistic expression, island seclusion, and the ultimate in creative living, The World Islands deliver an unmatched lifestyle. Their unique combination of man-made grandeur, natural beauty, and a prestigious Dubai address makes them one of the most desirable destinations in the world. This is a place where one can embark on a soulful journey to an island sanctuary — serene, inspiring and effortlessly connected to the city that has it all.
